item.title: The ultimate Christmas tree harvest - top tips to grow the best crop of trees
item.description: Christmas trees can be a challenging crop to grow, not least because of the time required between planting and harvest, with the British Christmas Tree Growers Association estimating a 6-7 foot tree is typically in the ground for 10-12 years. Careful site selection, ground preparation, establishment, and management throughout this growing period is therefore key to success, says Hutchinson's horticultural agronomist, Abi Rayment. item.title: Baroness Batters says Gov did not 'bury' Farm Profitability review
item.description: Baroness Batters has dismissed claims her long-awaited Farm Profitability Review has been buried, blaming instead a backlog of ‘government communications'. The former NFU president delivered her 50,000-word report which contained 56 recommendations to the department on October 31.
